Method of Attack: Infection via emails with password-protected archive attachments containing malicious macros
Stealing reply-chain emails to camouflage malicious emails as parts of existing conversations
Downloading additional files after initial infection to send fake emails or engage in other malicious activities
Use of malicious macro documents connecting to multiple malicious domains to download payloads
Deployment of second-stage malware payloads on infected systems
Discoverer: Lithuania's National Center for Public Health (NVSC)
Impacted Systems: Internal networks of Lithuania's National Center for Public Health (NVSC)
Lithuanian government officials, ministry representatives, and epidemiological diagnostics experts
Multiple US state and local governments
Attack Vector: Emails with infected messages opened by recipients
Emails sent as replies to previous conversations with password-protected archive attachments
Indicators of Compromise: Emails containing password-protected archives with passwords shared in email body
Malicious macro documents connecting to seven malicious domains
Emotet-infected emails sent from infected systems
